policy.statement: Rasters are text-free illustrations only. Every rules-bearing name, number, cost, timing and reminder is rendered at runtime from data/*.json (English) and the same fields' *Zh values (Simplified Chinese, docs/GLOSSARY_ZH_V1.6.1.md). A raster that prints rules text, even slightly different wording, is obsolete.
policy.legacyFileNames: File names under assets/current_v04 are stable legacy paths, not game IDs. A V1.6.1 component that reuses an illustration keeps the file's original name.
policy.retiredComponents: Produce nothing for a mechanic listed in AGENTS.md 'Explicitly obsolete mechanics'.

centralBoard.capacityRule: Absolute capacity: Materials Yard, Commission Market and Guild Hall 2/3/4 spaces at 2/3/4 players; Canal Wharf uncapped; Magistrate's Hall 1/1/2 spaces (cover the second space at 2-3 players). No overfill space is drawn.
centralBoard.illustrationNote: Background art only. The V1.4 board art shows more than five location areas; the V1.6.1 layout overlays exactly the five central locations above and draws no personal location on the central board.

sharedKilnBoard.layoutNote: Owner decision D8: Low (2 spaces, centred) under the dome at the top, Middle in the middle, High (3 spaces) at the bottom beside the firebox, because the wood fire burns at the bottom of the kiln.
sharedKilnBoard.illustrationNote: Kiln body art only; zone labels, modifiers and space counts are overlaid from data. assets/current_v04/shared_kiln_owner_reference.png shows an older layout and is not a V1.6.1 source.

eachBoardShows.kilnTradition: kilns[].name / nameZh, abilityName / abilityNameZh and shortText / shortTextZh from data
eachBoardShows.techSlotRule: At most 3 Techs, at most 1 per discipline

kilnMasterMarker.note: Placed face up on a ceramic when it is loaded, once per round (L647, L654); public, like the Imperial modifier.

crackleMarkers.note: Marker on the 1 ceramic of any Quality that Ge crackled after a firing (L482, change 39); it stays until the ceramic is delivered, exhibited or, if Flawed, sold (L116, L172). Never drawn as a Decoration.

vesselCards.ceramicArtCombinations: 5 Shapes x 4 Decorations (plain, carved, impressed, painted) plus the Crackle overlay

kilnContributionCards.fuelLedgerNote: Fuel Ledger brings 2 more Contribution cards with the tile, Fuel Ledger Bank (1 Wood, -2) and Fuel Ledger Stoke (1 Wood, +2) (v1.6.2 change 26). All 14 cards share one back, so a face-down card reveals nothing.
